defs.def: to work together with sb in order to produce or achieve sth 合作；协作

ex.s: My adviser saw this experience as a groundbreaking success, emphasising the collaborating skills I acquired.
ex.t: 我的导师将这次经历视为突破性的成功，强调我所获得的协作技能。

defs.def: to help the enemy who has taken control of your country during a war 通敌；勾结敌人

ex.s: In a world still facing so many problems, it is absolutely essential for us all to collaborate to create a global community with a shared future of peace and prosperity.
ex.t: 在一个仍然面临如此多问题的世界中，我们所有人都必须合作，以创建一个和平与繁荣的共同未来的全球社区。
